OperationStep.Arguments: /c if exist AnalyticsWorkspace rmdir /s /q AnalyticsWorkspace
OperationStep.Name: remove-analytics-workspace

OperationStep.Arguments: /c if exist MultiDimensionalWorkspace rmdir /s /q MultiDimensionalWorkspace
OperationStep.Name: remove-multi-dimensional-workspace

OperationStep.Arguments: new-workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}"
OperationStep.Name: new-analytics-workspace

OperationStep.Arguments: add-model --workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}" --id Commerce --name Commerce --default-culture en-US
OperationStep.Name: add-model

OperationStep.Arguments: add-data-source --workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}" --id Warehouse --model Commerce --name Warehouse --provider SqlServer --connection-reference COMMERCE_DW --source-kind Relational
OperationStep.Name: add-data-source

OperationStep.Arguments: add-table --workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}" --id Date --model Commerce --name Date --kind Dimension --data-category Time
OperationStep.Name: add-date-table

OperationStep.Arguments: add-attribute --workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}" --id DateKey --table Date --name DateKey --data-type-id meta:type:Int32 --is-key true --is-hidden true
OperationStep.Name: add-date-key

OperationStep.Arguments: add-table --workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}" --id Sales --model Commerce --name Sales --kind Fact
OperationStep.Name: add-sales-table

OperationStep.Arguments: add-attribute --workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}" --id OrderDateKey --table Sales --name OrderDateKey --data-type-id meta:type:Int32 --is-hidden true
OperationStep.Name: add-order-date-key

OperationStep.Arguments: add-attribute --workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}" --id SalesAmountColumn --table Sales --name SalesAmount --data-type-id meta:type:Decimal --is-hidden true
OperationStep.Name: add-sales-amount-column

OperationStep.Arguments: add-relationship --workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}" --id SalesOrderDate --name OrderDate --role-name OrderDate --relationship-kind Regular --cardinality ManyToOne --from-table Sales --from-attribute OrderDateKey --to-table Date --to-attribute DateKey --is-active true
OperationStep.Name: add-relationship

OperationStep.Arguments: add-measure --workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}" --id SalesAmount --table Sales --source-attribute SalesAmountColumn --name "Sales Amount" --data-type-id meta:type:Decimal --format-string "#,0.00"
OperationStep.Name: add-measure

OperationStep.Arguments: add-aggregation-behavior --workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}" --id SalesAmountAggregation --measure SalesAmount --function Sum
OperationStep.Name: add-aggregation

OperationStep.Arguments: add-security-role --workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}" --id Readers --model Commerce --name Readers --permission Read
OperationStep.Name: add-security-role

OperationStep.Arguments: analytics-to-multi-dimensional --workspace "{workspace:analytics.path}" --out "{workspace:multi-dimensional.path}"
OperationStep.Name: convert-to-multi-dimensional

OperationStep.Arguments: add-named-set --workspace "{workspace:multi-dimensional.path}" --id TopDates --cube Commerce:cube --name TopDates --expression "TOPCOUNT([Date].[DateKey].MEMBERS, 10, [Measures].[Sales Amount])"
OperationStep.Name: add-named-set

OperationStep.Arguments: add-cube-action --workspace "{workspace:multi-dimensional.path}" --id SalesDrillthrough --cube Commerce:cube --name "Sales Drillthrough" --action-type DrillThrough --target-kind Cells --expression DRILLTHROUGH
OperationStep.Name: add-cube-action

OperationStep.Arguments: add-cell-permission --workspace "{workspace:multi-dimensional.path}" --id ReaderSalesCells --security-role Readers --cube Commerce:cube --expression "Measures.CurrentMember IS [Measures].[Sales Amount]"
OperationStep.Name: add-cell-permission

OperationStep.Arguments: add-partition --workspace "{workspace:multi-dimensional.path}" --id SalesCurrent --measure-group "Sales:measure-group" --multi-dimensional-data-source Warehouse --name "Sales Current" --source-expression "SELECT * FROM mart.FactSales"
OperationStep.Name: add-partition

OperationStep.Arguments: deploy --workspace "{workspace:multi-dimensional.path}" --server {env:META_MULTI_DIMENSIONAL_DEMO_SERVER} --database-name {env:META_MULTI_DIMENSIONAL_DEMO_DATABASE} --drop-existing --no-process
OperationStep.Name: deploy-multi-dimensional
